embedding_geometry.interpretation: Raw ESM-2 cosine space is strongly anisotropic. Mangrove↔wetland neighborhood continuity persists after per-dimension z-scoring, but rumen transfer does not; use the graph for navigation, not mechanism attestation.

taxonomy.interpretation: Reciprocal mangrove↔wetland neighborhoods are substantially taxonomically structured. GTDB release metadata is present only for the POC lane, so source and taxonomy-release effects cannot be cleanly separated in this freeze.

functional_metric_provenance.public_action: Cross-lane methane/sulfur/substrate densities and the universal attestation ranking are quarantined. Raw annotation counts remain only as provenance diagnostics until the common accepted/present feature rebuild is complete.

mucc_validation_readiness.expression_units_status: processed detection/occupancy support; source normalization units remain unresolved, so no activity magnitude or flux inference
mucc_validation_readiness.claim_boundary: Expression is orthogonal processed detection evidence. ESS-DIVE flux and porewater observations are staged site/time context only: 0/133 sequencing samples currently have an authoritative exact sample-depth-environment-flux join.

findings.finding: Data-complete tri-view is not the same as mechanism-comparable tri-view.
findings.report_action: Use the four-state evidence contract everywhere; remove the former 4,980 canonical/mechanism-equivalent claim.

findings.finding: The former cross-lane methane density mixed incompatible numerators.
findings.result: MSM/Futian used raw many-to-many annotation rows plus all HMM rows; POC used curated accepted/present features; MUCC used source DRAM terms.
findings.report_action: Cross-lane methane/sulfur/substrate densities and the universal attestation ranking are quarantined. Raw annotation counts remain only as provenance diagnostics until the common accepted/present feature rebuild is complete.

findings.finding: The quarantined score was materially coupled to pipeline-specific methane counts.
findings.result: Pearson r=0.605; 99.4% of the legacy top 500 were mangrove rows.
findings.report_action: Mangrove candidates are now selected by geometry and QC only, with no cross-lane mechanism rank.

findings.finding: ESM-2 supports target-target neighborhood navigation, not rumen transfer.
findings.result: Raw reciprocal unique pairs: 15,727 mangrove↔wetland, 1 rumen↔wetland, 0 mangrove↔rumen. After dimension z-scoring: 15,064, 0, 0, respectively.
findings.report_action: Describe ESM-2 links as latent neighborhoods; forbid source-independent ecological or mechanism transfer claims.

findings.finding: Bridge taxonomy is structured and GTDB release is source-confounded.
findings.result: 79.2% of usable reciprocal mangrove↔wetland pairs match phylum after conservative synonym normalization; release metadata is absent outside POC.
findings.report_action: Treat bridge continuity as partly taxonomic homophily and require harmonized taxonomy/phylogeny-aware nulls.

findings.finding: MUCC expression and field-observation lanes are valuable but not yet joined.
findings.result: 1,358 MAGs have processed methane-gene detection and 1,868 sulfur; exact sample-environment-flux links=0/133.
findings.report_action: Surface expression as detection/occupancy support and staged flux as a validation lane; do not infer activity magnitude or flux.
